intent: Dashboard: the Docs view lists Gator HTML documents only, with readable labels
notes: The Docs sidebar now lists only Gator narrative HTML documents, the
`.html` files directly in `.gator/docs/`. Markdown and the repo-root
`docs/` folder are no longer listed there; they stay on disk and in the
Repo tree. The four Welcome documents come first, in Welcome order, then
any other document alphabetically. Every entry has a reader-friendly
label ("Start a session", not `start-a-session.html`). The first
document opens automatically in the sandboxed inline preview, and an
empty list tells the user to run Update.
